name: osmo-ai-receptionist
description: OsmO AI Receptionist for Grok Build: an AI phone receptionist and answering service for your own number. OsmO's AI answers and screens your calls; from Grok you see missed calls and what each caller wanted, open any call with its summary, transcript and recording link, screen a caller, call back someone who called you in the last 30 days, and change who is put through, VIP and block lists, caller rules, the assistant's language and bookings. Every call back and every change is shown to you first and happens only after you say yes. Needs an OsmO app plan with call forwarding on; sign in with your phone number, no API key.
